reviews.body: Thanks for tightening malformed tool-call handling. The intent looks right, but the Python CI is red because the existing error-path tests still index `trace.calls[0]` after this change. Invalid arguments now correctly avoid creating a tool-call record, so please update those assertions to inspect the tool error message / traced error instead, then rerun the Python suite.

Thanks for updating the error-path coverage. The tests now assert the reported tool error without assuming a call record exists, which matches the intended malformed-argument behavior. Focused Go and Python suites pass locally.
